title: 9 Things a Godly Man Does When He's Sick in Bed
caption:
Nothing humbles a strong guy faster than a fever.

You can't lift, can't work, can't do much of anything but lie there. Most men fight it, fake it, or scroll through it.

A godly man lets it teach him. He lets someone bring him soup. He prays short prayers and means them. He texts his guys so they can pray. He notices how much he took for granted when he was healthy.

"My grace is sufficient for you, for my power is made perfect in weakness." 2 Corinthians 12:9

Save this for the next time you're flat on your back. Send it to the guy who's sick right now.
